281. (Currently amended) A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and __at least two__ adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers and __a medial section between the first and second layers, the tool having a circular shape and including a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, wherein__ a first adhesive layer __is on a first side of the medial section between__ the first layer __and the medial section__, and a second adhesive layer __is on a second side of the medial section between__ the second layer __and the medial section__, __the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer being__ in registration with __the first layer and the second layer__.

282. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

283. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 282 wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

284. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 282 wherein the medial section is a composite material.

285. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a __segmented__ weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

286. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

287. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 285 wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

288. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

289. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is segmented.

290. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 285 further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

291. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 290 wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening.

293. (Currently amended) The tool of claim 281 further including a __segmented__ weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring.

294. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

295. (Previously presented) The tool of claim 293 wherein the weld ring is segmented.
